question: The arithmetic mean of the observations 78, 56, 52, 45, 97, 19, 37, 46 and 74 is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume an **Assumed Mean** (Base) = 50.

Calculate **deviations** from 50: +28, +6, +2, −5, +47, −31, −13, −4, +24.

Sum of deviations = 28 + 6 + 2 − 5 + 47 − 31 − 13 − 4 + 24 = 54.

Net Adjustment = Sum of deviations ÷ Number of observations = 54 ÷ 9 = 6.

Actual Mean = Assumed Mean + Adjustment = 50 + 6 = 56.

**∴ The correct answer is 56.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Observations are 78, 56, 52, 45, 97, 19, 37, 46, and 74.

**Formula Used:** **Arithmetic Mean** = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total number of observations)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a7269efd508916fbe3074aa78e072783f50df5fb53cf7e5bc79de6cd340f411.png] 

⇒ Total number of **observations** (n) = 9

⇒ **Sum** = 78 + 56 + 52 + 45 + 97 + 19 + 37 + 46 + 74

⇒ **Sum** = 504

⇒ **Arithmetic Mean** = 504 ÷ 9

⇒ **Arithmetic Mean** = 56

**∴ The correct answer is 56.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Arithmetic Mean

The **sum of deviations** of items from their **Arithmetic Mean** is always **zero**: Σ(x − Mean) = 0.

Change in Origin and Scale

If each observation is increased by **k**, the mean increases by **k**. If each is multiplied by **k**, the mean is multiplied by **k**.

Mean of Natural Numbers

The mean of the first **n** natural numbers is calculated using the formula: **(n + 1) ÷ 2**.</p
